name: Staffing

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: No dedicated Staffing section in the 2QFY27 compendium; coverage appears only in MOFSL's sector tables
mofsl_2qfy27.read: MOFSL's Exhibit 8 shows its 4-company Staffing universe with sales of INR131b (+15% YoY, 1% above estimates), EBITDA INR4b (+23% YoY, 3% above) and PAT INR2b (+34% YoY, 13% above). The earnings-revision table moves staffing FY27E PAT from INR9b to INR10b (+1.9%) and FY28E from INR11b to INR11b (-1.6%). The review prints no sector commentary, company-level surprises, misses or guidance for staffing.

unit_economics: Staffing EBITDA = average associates x months x (markup per associate per month - cost to serve); revenue includes associate wages as a pass-through, so EBITDA margin on gross revenue is about 1-1.6% for general staffing and 3.5-6% for facility services.

price_drivers.why: Wages pass through at zero margin, so profit moves only with markup; TeamLease PAPM has stayed near INR665-689 while general-staffing margin held 1.0-1.1% for nine quarters.

price_drivers.driver: Net headcount additions and open mandates
price_drivers.why: Associates drive revenue and 80JJAA eligibility; insourcing events (TeamLease ~23k at one NBFC) and falling open mandates cut growth.
Codes in force from Nov-25 and state wage steps of 20-47% lift revenue and dilute margin; they favour organised players or push clients to direct fixed-term hiring.
TeamLease ETR was 5.9% in FY26 with a INR36.6 cr benefit (~23% of PBT); disallowance would cut EPS sharply.
Pay-first segments and government receivables stretch DSO, and PF and GST demands are large against net worth.

kpis.name: Billable associates and net additions
kpis.definition: End-period associates by segment with net adds, split between sourced and transferred and excluding named insourcing events.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Headcount is the volume driver of gross profit; the market reacts to net adds and open mandates (TeamLease ~17.5k, Quess ~37k) more than to PAT.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'associates' and 'headcount' for TEAMLEASE, QUESS, SIS, UDS; transcripts for open mandates and insourcing events.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; company statements and broker headcount models (HSIE, Emkay, IIFL); get_consensus_estimates for revenue as a cross-check.
kpis.traps: Direct vs transferred hires; apprentices and DA counted differently by brokers; one-off insourcing events.

kpis.name: Markup per associate per month (PAPM)
kpis.definition: Gross profit per associate per month on the company's definition and on house basis.
kpis.formula: Segment gross profit / average associates / months
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Markup is the only profit lever in a pass-through model; client-size ladder runs from about INR300-500 for large clients to over INR1,000 for small ones, so mix shifts PAPM without any price move.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'PAPM' or 'markup'; transcripts (TeamLease gives it on calls); HSIE and Emkay initiations in report library for house PAPM.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; management commentary and broker models (HSIE, Emkay, IIFL).
kpis.traps: Company PAPM undefined at Quess; planned exits of low-PAPM clients raise average without pricing; pass-through billing dilutes margin %.

kpis.name: EBITDA per associate per month and conversion of markup
kpis.definition: General-staffing EBITDA per associate and share of markup converted to EBITDA after core cost.
kpis.formula: EBITDA / average associates / months; EBITDA / gross profit
kpis.why_it_moves_price: TeamLease holds roughly INR285-292 per associate per month, converting ~40% of markup; cost-to-serve and associate-to-core ratio determine operating leverage when PAPM is flat.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment results; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA' by segment; HSIE Jan-25 Quess IC and Emkay Dec-24 TeamLease IC in the library.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates EBITDA; broker models (TEAMLEASE_model_v2 reference); no consensus per associate.
kpis.traps: Deck EBITDA vs filed segment result differ; unallocated cost; TeamLease count includes DA at some brokers.

kpis.name: Professional and specialised staffing growth and margin
kpis.definition: Revenue and EBITDA margin of IT, GCC and specialised staffing.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Specialised staffing is ~6% of TeamLease revenue but ~30% of profit and earns 6-13% margin, so GCC hiring swings group earnings.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment note; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'specialised' or 'professional'; transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; company commentary and broker segment models.
kpis.traps: TeamLease restated specialised revenue without explanation; MSP pass-through dilutes margin.

kpis.name: Days sales outstanding and cash conversion
kpis.definition: Trade receivables plus unbilled revenue over revenue, by segment, with OCF to EBITDA excluding tax refunds.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Facility and security businesses carry 60-90 days and fund payroll; TeamLease quotes 6-7 days against ~25 days implied, so definition risk affects the cash multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet; annual reports via read_library_document; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'DSO'.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; management targets on calls (SIS OCF/EBITDA 60-65%).
kpis.traps: Companies define DSO differently; gratuity reimbursement right grossed up balance sheets by about INR390-400 cr at TeamLease.

kpis.name: Effective tax rate and 80JJAA dependence
kpis.definition: Tax deduction on incremental employee cost and its share of PBT.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: A disallowance moves EPS by 20-40%; Quess carries a qualified standalone audit opinion over claims and TeamLease has reassessments pending.
kpis.history_source: get_financials tax reconciliation; annual reports via read_library_document for contingent liabilities.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus on tax outcome; brokers show EPS at reported and statutory rate.
kpis.traps: Associates under client supervision are the dispute ground; claims depend on net additions.

kpis.name: Facility and security segment EBITDA margin and wage repricing
kpis.definition: Margin of security, FM and IFM businesses after minimum-wage pass-through lag.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Cost-plus contracts reprice after a lag, so state wage steps cut margin for 1-2 quarters; India security margin runs 4.5-6%, FM 4-6.5%.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'segment EBITDA' for SIS and UDS; transcripts for repricing lag.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates; company margin targets (SIS India security 6%).
kpis.traps: UDS deck EBITDA includes other income; SIS gratuity treatment differs; acquisitions distort constant-currency growth.

valuation_anchor: P/E on normalised EPS at both reported and statutory tax rate (TeamLease broker range 13-18x, Quess higher), SOTP on segment EV/EBITDA, and for facility businesses EV/EBITDA by segment; build own band from price history.
watch_next_quarter: MOFSL gives no staffing guidance in this review; monitor Q3 open mandates and net adds at TeamLease and Quess, state labour-code rule notifications, minimum-wage repricing at SIS and UDS, and any 80JJAA ruling.
